notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but Gold can be obtained any number of times.
The second run of this event also featured Skill Chips for the first time.
